elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause applies upon expiry or termination of the Agreement or any Order Form for any reason.

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Vendor must, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly provided at Vendor's then-current rates.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The 30-day deadline runs from Customer's request, not from expiry or termination; a later request could delay return beyond 30 days after expiry or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Vendor must return or make available for download all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: After the return/download step, Vendor must delete Customer Data, subject to routine backups and legal retention, and certify deletion in writing.

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause applies upon expiry or termination of the Agreement or any Order Form for any reason.

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Transition assistance is available for up to six months, which includes a requested 90-day period.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Although making Customer Data available for download is an export, the 30-day deadline runs from Customer's request rather than from expiry or termination.
